biography.value:
Description

Sinspawn are presumably fiends that are formed by outlets of the multitude of pyreflies that composes Sin's physical form. Collectively, the forms of Sinspawn coincide with those of reef-dwelling creatures, such as anemones and jellyfish. - DMLeibfrid

Absorb Water; Defensive Ability Full Defense; Immune Antagonized, Blind, Disable, Doom, Gravity, Petrification/Statue, Poison, Sleep, Zombie

Weakness Fire

Offense

Melee 2 Tentacles +16 (2d6+9 plus poison)

Space 15 ft.; Reach 15 ft.

Special Attacks Sigh, Staccato

Spells Known (SC CL 10th, Concentration +15)

1st (DC 16) - Water

2nd (DC 17) - Water II

3rd (DC 18) - Water III

Statistics

Str 28, Dex 7, Con 29, Int 4, Wis 20, Cha 12

Base Atk +9; CMB +20; CMD 28

Feats Blind-Fight, Cleave, Extra MP, Power Attack, Toughness, Vital Strike

Skills Fly +4, Perception +15, Stealth +12

Ecology

Organization solitary
